item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 10 #VISPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 10 #VISPRSD
Issued at 02:25 PM 14 August 2026

Moderate to Heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #Capiz(RoxasCity, Panay, Sigma, Pontevedra, Panitan, Jamindan), #Iloilo(BarotacNuevo, Pototan, NewLucena, Cabatuan, Alimodian, Leon, Tubungan, Igbaras), #OccidentalMindoro(SantaCruz, Sablayan, Paluan, Mamburao, AbraDeIlog), #Palawan(Busuanga, Coron, Bataraza and Narra) within the next 1 to 2 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #Capiz(SapiAn, Ivisan, Mambusao), #Aklan(Batan, Altavas, NewWashington, Balete, Banga, Kalibo, Libacao), #Iloilo(Guimbal, Tigbauan, Oton, Pavia, SanMiguel, IloiloCity, Leganes, Zarraga, Dumangas, SantaBarbara), #OccidentalMindoro(Lubang, Looc), #Palawan(Quezon, SofronioEspanola, Brooke'sPoint and Rizal) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides. Keep monitoring for updates.
